extracted.name: Watermelon Caprese Appetizer
extracted.description: Watermelon, mozzarella cheese, and basil appetizer skewers are drizzled with olive oil and balsamic vinegar in this fun twist on a caprese salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 small watermelon, fruit removed with a melon baller
1 (8 ounce) package fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into small pieces
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Trim basil leaves into small circles about 1 inch in diameter.
Thread watermelon and mozzarella cheese on toothpicks, sandwiching a basil leaf in between. Arrange on a serving plate.
Pour olive oil and balsamic vinegar over toothpicks. Sprinkle salt and black pepper on top.
